question: Radha can complete a piece of work in 3 days, while Raji can complete the same work in 2 days. Both of them complete this work by working together and get ₹150 as total payment for the work done. What is the share of Radha out of the above payment?
solution:
**Given:** 

Radha can complete a piece of work in 3 days, while Raji can complete the same work in 2 days. Both of them complete this work by working together and get ₹150 as total payment for the work done.

**Formula used:**

Total work = LCM

Time =( Work)/(Efficiency)

Ratio of x and y is (x)/(y)

**Calculation:**

Work done by Radha in one day is (1)/(3) 

Work done by Raji in one day is (1)/(2) 

Hence, the ratio of their contribution to daily work is (2)/(3)

Let Radha's pay be x and Raji's pay be 150 - x.

Then, (x)/(150-x)=(2)/(3)

Solving for x,

3x=300-2x

x=(300)/(5)=60

**∴ Radha's pay is ₹ 60**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

LCM of (2, 3) = 6 = Total Work

Efficiency =frac{ Work} { Time}

Efficiency of Radha =(6)/(3) = 2

Efficiency of Raji = (6)/(2) = 3

Since payment will be done according to the efficiency so,

Radha's pay = (Radha Efficiency)/(Total Efficiency)times Total Payment

Radha' pay = (2)/(5)×150 = ₹ 60
